content.text:
The BooleanExpr column of the ACE table has a type of AC_element.  Table 210 contains an encoding
example of the AC_element list representing the infix ACE expression:
((00 00 00 09 00 00 00 32 AND 00 00 00 09 00 00 00 24) OR 00 00 00 09 00 00 82 73) AND 00 00 00
09 00 00 77 28
